title: ProductFreedomFromRisk
description: ISO 25010-sourced quality archetype — Freedom from Risk quality-in-use characteristic. Measures the degree to which a product mitigates potential risk to economic status, human life, health, or the environment. Sub-characteristics: Economic risk mitigation, Health and safety risk mitigation, Environmental risk mitigation. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms. Source: ISO/IEC 25010 (Quality in Use — Freedom from Risk).

economicRiskMitigation.description: Degree to which the product mitigates potential risk to financial status, efficient operation, commercial property, reputation, or other resources.

healthSafetyRiskMitigation.description: Degree to which the product mitigates potential risk to people in the intended contexts of use.

environmentalRiskMitigation.description: Degree to which the product mitigates potential risk to property or the environment.
